data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 文集装订的最后一道线
data.description: 周末整理古典部文集，爱瑠穿淡紫衬衫和藏蓝背带长裙坐在活动室桌边。一手压住书脊，另一手将松开的装订线轻轻拉直；她停下来检查针脚，紫色双眼因发现不齐的一处而认真睁大。
data.action: 一手压书脊，一手拉直装订线，认真检查错位针脚。
data.promptProse: At the old Classical Literature Club worktable, Chitanda sits on a wooden chair and presses the anthology flat beside its stitched spine. Her other hand pinches the short end of the binding thread close to one empty hole. Her violet eyes widen as she notices the uneven stitch. A spool, a spare needle and a ruler lie on the near edge among squared paper offcuts. Afternoon window light falls across the book and the pinched fold of her rolled lilac cuff. The club's glass-front cabinet and the remaining anthologies sit deeper in the room.
data.animaCaption: The open anthology lies flat on the table under her left palm. Her other hand draws one short length of thread just above the binding hole, and her gaze follows the stitches.
